paper_title: Oscillating nuclear charge radii as sensors for ultralight dark matter
notes: QCD axion decay constant bounds from Figure 2. Experimental bound derived from 26-month frequency ratio measurement (ν_E3/ν_E2) using single trapped 171Yb+ ion comparing electric octupole (E3) and electric quadrupole (E2) transitions. Data source: visual extraction from Figure 2 (dark red exclusion curve boundary). Y-axis converted from eV^-1 to GeV^-1 (multiply by 10^9). DM density assumed ρ_DM = 0.4 GeV/cm³. Paper presents both scalar UDM (Figure 1) and QCD axion (Figure 2) results; QCD axion selected as main result due to broader mass range (6×10^-23 to 2×10^-17 eV) and direct mapping to AxionMass canonical coupling. Limits are 95% confidence level upper bounds from search for sinusoidal modulations in frequency ratio.
